Asafo mu asomfo yie
1 # Aso 4.35 Na nna no mu a asuafoɔ no redɔɔso no, huhuhuhu baa Helenifoɔ no mu tiaa Hebrifoɔ no sɛ wɔbu wɔn ani gu wɔn akunafoɔ so daa ɔhwɛ a wɔhwɛ wɔn no mu. 2Na dummienu no frɛɛ asuafokuo no bae, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɛmfata sɛ yɛbɛgya Nyankopɔn asɛm akɔsom apono soɔ. 3#1 Ti 3.7-8 Enti, anuanom, mompɛ mo mu mmarima baason a wɔwɔ din pa a Honhom ne nyansa ahyɛ wɔn ma, na yɛmfa wɔn nsi adwuma yi so; 4na yɛn deɛ, yɛbɛkɔ so ara akura mpaebɔ ne anyamesɛm no som mu. 5#Aso 8.5 Na asɛm no sɔɔ nnipakuo no nyinaa ani. Na wɔyii Stefano, ɔbarima a gyidie ne Honhom Kronkron ahyɛ no ma, ne Filipo ne Prokoro ne Nikanor ne Timon ne Parmena ne Nikolao a ɔfiri Antiokia a wadane Yudani. 6#Aso 1.24; 13.3; 14.23 Yeinom na wɔde wɔn gyinaa asomafoɔ no anim, na wɔsɔree de wɔn nsa guu wɔn so.
7 # Aso 19.20 Na Nyankopɔn asɛm no kɔɔ so, na asuafoɔ no dɔree pii wɔ Yerusalem, na asɔfoɔ no mu pii nso yɛɛ setie maa gyidie no.
Stefano kyerɛ
8Na Stefano a gyidie ne tumi ahyɛ no ma no yɛɛ anwanwadeɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ akɛseɛ ɔman no mu. 9Na nnipa bi a wɔfiri hyiadan a wɔfrɛ no Fawohodiefoɔ Hyiadan ne Kirenefoɔ ne Aleksandriafoɔ ne wɔn a wɔfiri Kilikia ne Asia sɔreeɛ, na wɔne Stefano gyee akyinnyeɛ, 10#Luk 21.15 nanso wɔantumi annyina nyansa ne honhom a ɔde kasaeɛ no ano. 11#Mat 26.60-66 Ɛnna wɔne nnipa bi hyehyɛ maa wɔkaa sɛ: Yɛate sɛ ɔkaa abususɛm tiaa Mose ne Onyankopɔn. 12Na wɔhwanyann ɔman no ne mpanimfoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no mu, na wɔbaa ne so bɛkyeree no twee no kɔɔ dwa mu. 13#Yer 26.11 Na wɔde adansekurumfoɔ bɛgyinaa hɔ a wɔse: Onipa yi nnyaee abususɛm a ɔka tia kronkronbea hɔ ne mmara no. 14Na yɛate sɛ ɔkaa sɛ: Yesu Nasareni yi bɛsɛe ha, na wasakyera amanneɛ a Mose de ama yɛn no. 15Na wɔn a wɔte dwa mu hɔ no nyinaa hwɛɛ no dinn, na wɔhunuu sɛ n’anim te sɛ ɔsoro bɔfoɔ bi anim.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na nna no mu a asuafoɔ no redɔɔso no, huhuhuhu baa Helenifoɔ no mu tiaa Hebrifoɔ no sɛ wɔbu wɔn ani gu wɔn akunafoɔ so daa ɔhwɛ a wɔhwɛ wɔn no mu. Na dummienu no frɛɛ asuafokuo no bae, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɛmfata sɛ yɛbɛgya Nyankopɔn asɛm akɔsom apono soɔ. Enti, anuanom, mompɛ mo mu mmarima baason a wɔwɔ din pa a Honhom ne nyansa ahyɛ wɔn ma, na yɛmfa wɔn nsi adwuma yi so; na yɛn deɛ, yɛbɛkɔ so ara akura mpaebɔ ne anyamesɛm no som mu. Na asɛm no sɔɔ nnipakuo no nyinaa ani. Na wɔyii Stefano, ɔbarima a gyidie ne Honhom Kronkron ahyɛ no ma, ne Filipo ne Prokoro ne Nikanor ne Timon ne Parmena ne Nikolao a ɔfiri Antiokia a wadane Yudani. Yeinom na wɔde wɔn gyinaa asomafoɔ no anim, na wɔsɔree de wɔn nsa guu wɔn so.
Na Nyankopɔn asɛm no kɔɔ so, na asuafoɔ no dɔree pii wɔ Yerusalem, na asɔfoɔ no mu pii nso yɛɛ setie maa gyidie no.

Na Stefano a gyidie ne tumi ahyɛ no ma no yɛɛ anwanwadeɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ akɛseɛ ɔman no mu. Na nnipa bi a wɔfiri hyiadan a wɔfrɛ no Fawohodiefoɔ Hyiadan ne Kirenefoɔ ne Aleksandriafoɔ ne wɔn a wɔfiri Kilikia ne Asia sɔreeɛ, na wɔne Stefano gyee akyinnyeɛ, nanso wɔantumi annyina nyansa ne honhom a ɔde kasaeɛ no ano. Ɛnna wɔne nnipa bi hyehyɛ maa wɔkaa sɛ: Yɛate sɛ ɔkaa abususɛm tiaa Mose ne Onyankopɔn. Na wɔhwanyann ɔman no ne mpanimfoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no mu, na wɔbaa ne so bɛkyeree no twee no kɔɔ dwa mu. Na wɔde adansekurumfoɔ bɛgyinaa hɔ a wɔse: Onipa yi nnyaee abususɛm a ɔka tia kronkronbea hɔ ne mmara no. Na yɛate sɛ ɔkaa sɛ: Yesu Nasareni yi bɛsɛe ha, na wasakyera amanneɛ a Mose de ama yɛn no. Na wɔn a wɔte dwa mu hɔ no nyinaa hwɛɛ no dinn, na wɔhunuu sɛ n’anim te sɛ ɔsoro bɔfoɔ bi anim.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
